title: Selters, Ulm & Munich
route: Frankfurt → Central European Branch Office → Ulm → Munich
intro: The final major travel day in Germany begins in Frankfurt and heads first to Selters for a visit to the Central European Branch Office. From there, the journey continues south with a stop in Ulm before finishing the day in Munich for the final nights of The Long Way Around.

stops.name: Frankfurt
stops.description: Leave Frankfurt and begin the journey south through Germany.

stops.name: Central European Branch Office
stops.description: Visit the Central European Bethel Branch Office in Selters.

stops.name: Ulm
stops.description: Stop in Ulm for some time around the historic center and Münsterplatz before continuing toward Munich.

stops.name: Munich
stops.description: Arrive in Munich and settle in for the final stretch of the trip.
